{{Top|leg}}
'''Berav''' was an inland settlement in the northwestern corner of the [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] continent of [[Keshtah Minor]]. Following the discovery of the continent of [[Alanciar]] in [[2975 BBY]], the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] commissioned the construction of new docks situated to the west of Berav the [[2974 BBY|following year]]. These docks were constructed in order to cater for Alanciari mariners.
